patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I tripped on the rug and bumped my head — barely anything, I feel completely fine. My wife made me come in. Oh, I take that blood thinner, warfarin, for my heart rhythm.
clinical.presentationShort: 78yo M on warfarin ? ground-level fall with head strike; feels well, GCS 15, no focal neurological deficit.
clinical.presentationLong: 78-year-old male taking warfarin for atrial fibrillation after a ground-level fall with a head strike. He feels well, has a GCS of 15, and has no focal neurological deficit.

diagnosis.primary: Head injury on anticoagulation (risk of intracranial hemorrhage)
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → non-contrast head CT now, reverse if bleed (PCC/vit K), serial neuro checks; anticoagulation makes a trivial bump lethal.
diagnosis.why: The scariest 'I feel fine.' On warfarin/DOAC a minor head bump can bleed hours later — always CT.
diagnosis.redFlag: Anticoagulation + ANY head strike = CT even if asymptomatic; bleeds can be delayed for hours.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 78-year-old man, well-dressed, a small bruise on his forehead
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting comfortably, looking mildly annoyed at being here
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 78-year-old man, well-dressed, with a small bruise on his forehead, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting comfortably, arms relaxed, looking mildly annoyed to be here. Expression: calm and a little exasperated. Clearly visible: a small bruise on the forehead; he otherwise looks completely well. No text, no logos.
